verdict.rationale: Mem0 Open Source is documented as the same memory engine as the Platform, running on your own infrastructure, where you own "the stack, the data, and every component". It also ships a self-hosted Docker stack with a REST API and dashboard, so self-hosting is clearly supported. The pack never shows the engine embedded in-process as a library, never shows it running against local LLM or embedding models, and never states that it runs with zero cloud dependency. missing for 10: evidence of in-process/embedded library mode, documented local LLM/embedding model support (e.g., local model providers), explicit fully-offline/no-cloud operation, independent hands-on corroboration.
